components.note: 鸟 (bird) — marks birds, as in 鸭 duck, 鸡 chicken, 鹅 goose.
合 (hé) is only a loose sound clue — 鸽 is gē; 合 also sounds out 哈 hā and 给 gěi.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metal radical; 镖 is a metal dart, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 钟 bell.
票 (piào) shares the rhyme with biāo; it also sounds out 飘 piāo and 漂 piāo/piào.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids; 沟 is a ditch or channel, as in 河 river, 海 sea.
勾 (gōu) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 钩 gōu (hook) and 构 gòu.
卜 (divination) — the cracks read on heated bones; marks fortune-telling, as in 占 zhān to divine.
圭 (guī) is a loose sound clue; 挂 guà (to hang) shares this part and is exactly guà.
口 (mouth) — 哭 has two mouths 吅 wailing aloud; 口 marks mouth and voice words, as in 叫 shout, 唱 sing.
氵 (water) — the tears; also in 汗 sweat, 泪 tear.
立 (lì) is only a loose sound clue today, far from qì.
亻 (person, 单人旁) — marks people and relationships, as in 他 he, 们 plural, 住 live.
至 (zhì) nearly matches zhí, with a different tone; it also sounds out 致 zhì and 室 shì.
亻 (person) — Buddha is a person; the same part marks people, as in 仙 immortal, 你 you.
弗 (fú) gives the sound as in 仿佛 fǎng fú; it also sounds out 费 fèi and 拂 fú.
氵 (water) — marks liquids; 汁 is juice or sap, as in 汤 soup, 酒 liquor.
十 (shí) is only a loose sound clue for zhī.
巾 — a piece of cloth hanging from a line; marks cloth items, as in 布 cloth, 帽 hat, 帐 curtain.
宀 (roof) — a quiet house; marks shelter and rooms, as in 家 home, 安 peace.
叔 (shū) is only a loose sound clue for jì.
宀 (roof) — a still, empty house; also in 家 home, 安 peace.
莫 (mò) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 墓 mù, 幕 mù, 摸 mō and 膜 mó.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants; 芯 is a plant's pith or core, as in 花 flower, 草 grass.
心 (xīn, heart) gives the exact sound and the idea: the heart of the plant, as in 灯芯 lamp wick.
木 (wood) — 核 is a fruit stone or kernel; 木 marks trees and wood, as in 树 tree, 桌 table.
亥 (hài) is a loose sound clue; it also sounds out 孩 hái, 咳 ké and 刻 kè.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metal restraints; also in 钱 money, 铁 iron.
考 (kǎo) is the same syllable with a different tone; it also sounds out 烤 kǎo and 拷 kǎo.
口 (mouth) — speaking instructions; also in 叫 shout, 问 ask.
属 (shǔ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 瞩 zhǔ, as in 嘱咐.
亻 (person) — companions are people; also in 他 he, 伴 partner.
吕 (lǚ) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 铝 lǚ (aluminium).
囗 (enclosure) — a walled-in border; 固 is something fenced in and firm, as in 国 country, 围 surround.
古 (gǔ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 故 gù, 姑 gū and 苦 kǔ.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — 锻 is forging metal; also in 钱 money, 铁 iron.
段 (duàn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 缎 duàn (satin) and 煅 duàn.
火 (fire) — smelting and refining with fire; also in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp.
柬 (jiǎn) is only a loose clue; 炼 liàn sounds like 练 liàn (practice) and 链 liàn (chain).
册 — bamboo slips bound with a cord, the ancient book; today a volume or register, as in 手册 manual, 注册 register.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — a body-part radical, as in 脸 face, 脚 foot, 胖 fat; 肿 is flesh swelling.
中 (zhōng) gives a close sound, with a different tone; 种 zhǒng shares the same pair.
疒 (illness) — marks diseases and ailments, as in 病 sick, 痛 pain; 瘤 is a growth.
留 (liú) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 溜 liū and 榴 liú.
亻 (person) — a good-looking person; also in 他 he, 优 excellent.
夋 (qūn) is a loose clue; it starts the jùn series 骏 jùn, 峻 jùn, 竣 jùn.
木 — a tree with trunk, branches and roots; the wood radical, as in 林 forest, 树 tree, 桌 table.
心 (heart) — worry and suffering weigh on the heart; also in 想 think, 急 anxious.
串 (chuàn) rhymes with huàn but is only a loose sound clue.
攵 (tap, strike; 攴) — hitting actions, as in 收 gather, 教 teach, 改 change.
高 (gāo) is a loose sound clue for qiāo; it also appears in 搞 gǎo and 稿 gǎo.
氵 (water) — nourishing moisture, as in 汤 soup, 河 river.
兹 (zī) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 磁 cí and 慈 cí.
氵 (water) — 洋 is the ocean, as in 海 sea, 河 river.
羊 (yáng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 样 yàng, 养 yǎng and 详 xiáng.
雨 (rain) — weather radical, as in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder; with 隹 (bird) it pictures birds startled in a storm, hence suddenly.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — appears in bird characters like 难, 谁, 集.
敝 (bì) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 蔽 bì (to cover), as in 作弊 to cheat.
氵 (water) — a stream to cross; also in 河 river, 游 swim.
步 (step) — steps through water: wading, hence being involved in something.
彳 (step, 双人旁) — walking and journeys, as in 行 go, 往 toward, 得; 征 is a march or campaign.
正 (zhèng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 证 zhèng, 政 zhèng and 整 zhěng.
虫 (insect) — small creatures, as in 蛇 snake, 蚊 mosquito, 蝴蝶 butterfly.
扁 (biǎn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 编 biān and 篇 piān.
虫 (insect) — small creatures, as in 蛇 snake, 蚊 mosquito.
畐 (fú) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 福 fú. Bats are lucky in China since 蝠 sounds like 福 fortune.
日 (sun) — spring is when the sun warms and plants sprout; also in 明 bright, 时 time.
氵 (water) — muddy, mixed water; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
军 (jūn) is a loose sound clue; it also sounds out 挥 huī and 辉 huī.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — hand actions; 搅 is to stir, as in 打 hit, 拉 pull.
觉 (jiào/jué) gives a close sound, as in 睡觉 shuì jiào.
氵 (water) — leaking liquid; also in 漏 leak, 流 flow.
世 (shì) is only a loose sound clue for xiè.
心 (heart) — feeling better; also in 想 think, 感 feel.
俞 (yú) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 愉 yú and 逾 yú.
鸟 (bird) — marks birds, as in 鸡 chicken, 鹅 goose, 鸽 pigeon.
甲 (jiǎ) is only a loose clue, but 押 yā shares this part with the same sound as 鸭.
口 (mouth) — calling out; 召 itself sounds out 招 zhāo, 照 zhào and 超 chāo.
刀 (dāo) is only a loose sound clue for zhào.
口 (mouth) — calling out loud; also in 叫 shout, 喊 yell.
奂 (huàn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 换 huàn, 焕 huàn and 痪 huàn.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 推 push, 拉 pull; 抵 is to push against.
氐 (dī) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 低 dī and 底 dǐ.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — thread and rein; 纵 is to let loose, as in 红 red, 级 level.
从 (cóng) rhymes loosely with zòng.
尸 (body) — a body with 毛 fur behind it is a tail; 尸 also in 屁, 尿 and 层.
毛 (hair, fur) — the furry tip hanging off the back.
